shellCommands.command:
PORT=3456 node server.js > /tmp/books.log 2>&1 &
S=$!; sleep 0.7
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home:%{http_code}\n" localhost:3456/
LOC=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}" -d "title=Dune&author=Frank Herbert&notes=Hook line." localhost:3456/books)
echo "created -> $LOC"
curl -s "$LOC" | grep -o "Frank Herbert\|Hook line.\|Mark as finished\|http://localhost:3456/books/[a-f0-9-]*" | sort -u
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish:%{http_code}\n" -X POST "$LOC/finish"
curl -s "$LOC" | grep -c "Currently reading" 
kill $S; sleep 0.3
PORT=3457 node server.js > /tmp/books2.log 2>&1 &
S2=$!; sleep 0.7
curl -s localhost:3457/ | grep -c "Dune"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing:%{http_code}\n" localhost:3457/books/nope
kill $S2
